Botany , also called phytology or plant science , is the branch of natural science and biology that studies plants , especially their anatomy , taxonomy , and ecology . [ 1 ] A botanist or plant scientist is a scientist who specialises in this field. " Plant " and "botany" may be defined more narrowly to include only land plants and their study, which is also known as phytology . Phytologists or botanists (in the strict sense) study approximately 410,000 species of land plants , including some 391,000 species of vascular plants (of which approximately 369,000 are flowering plants ) [ 2 ] and approximately 20,000 bryophytes . [ 3 ]
